name: Woodmont Way
location: West Windsor, Mercer County, NJ: off Meadow Road just west of US Route 1, behind MarketFair, along Canal Pointe Boulevard
summary: A 443-unit, 13-building garden-style rental community completed in 2022, with a two-story clubhouse, a resort-style pool with cabana, detached garages, and a private patio or balcony for every home.

units.label: Apartment units
units.quote: "a new 443-unit luxury apartment complex in West Windsor" (Real Estate NJ); "443-unit, garden-style, luxury multi-housing community" (JLL)

residentialBuildingCount.label: Residential buildings
residentialBuildingCount.derivation: OpenStreetMap maps 12 apartment buildings plus the clubhouse on the site; 12 + 1 matches JLL's 13 buildings. Garages and the maintenance building are read as accessory structures outside that count.

footprints.label: Building footprints
footprints.derivation: Each building's polygon is the OSM way in osm-extract.json, converted to metres. They line up closely with Esri World Imagery on a visual overlay; they are traced outlines, not surveyed, and may include roof overhangs.

patioOrBalcony.label: Private outdoor space
patioOrBalcony.value: every home has a private patio or balcony
patioOrBalcony.quote: "all homes offering a private patio or balcony" (Real Estate NJ, March 2021)

ceilingHeight.label: Apartment ceiling height
ceilingHeight.quote: "plank floors, 9-foot ceilings, walk-in closets, gourmet kitchens"

clubhouseStories.label: Clubhouse stories
clubhouseStories.quote: "Community amenities include a two-story clubhouse, a swimming pool and sundeck" (JLL)

pool.label: Pool and cabana
pool.quote: "resort-style swimming pool and cabana" (Real Estate NJ, October 2021); pool outline is OSM way 1375161104 (leisure=swimming_pool)

garages.label: Detached garages
garages.value: detached garages and storage units for rent
garages.quote: "The property will have detached garages and storage units available for rent." (Multi-Housing News); OSM maps two detached garage buildings (ways 1518661325, 1518661331)

location.label: Location
location.value: off Meadow Road, just west of Route 1, along Canal Pointe Boulevard
location.quote: "located off Meadow Road and just west of Route 1" (Real Estate NJ); "The 23-acre plot along Canal Pointe Boulevard" (Community News)

residentialStories.label: Residential stories
residentialStories.estimate: Not published. The pool-view photo and the aerial rendering show four floors of windows on most buildings; the entrance rendering shows three above grade on a sloping corner. Modelled as 4 on every residential building. Density check: 4 stories over the OSM footprints gives about 1,820 gross SF per unit, high for garden apartments, so some buildings may be 3 stories (or the OSM outlines include overhangs). This is the largest uncertainty in the scene; a per-building correction goes in storiesByWay in woodmont-way/build.ts.

floorToFloor.label: Floor-to-floor height
floorToFloor.estimate: 10 ft: the published 9-ft ceilings plus about 1 ft of wood-frame floor structure.

residentialRoof.label: Residential roof
residentialRoof.estimate: Hip roofs with dormers are visible in the renderings and photos; the pitch is not published.

roofPitch.label: Roof pitch
roofPitch.estimate: Read by eye from the entrance rendering and pool photo.

roofOverhang.label: Eave overhang
roofOverhang.estimate: Typical for this construction type; not published.

exteriorWall.label: Exterior wall thickness
exteriorWall.estimate: Wood frame with siding and brick base; not published.

accessoryHeight.label: Garage and maintenance building height
accessoryHeight.estimate: One story, read from the aerial rendering.

clubhouseFloorToFloor.label: Clubhouse floor-to-floor height
clubhouseFloorToFloor.estimate: 12 ft, typical for amenity space; not published.

streetWidth.label: Public street paving width (Canal Pointe Blvd, Meadow Rd, Wheeler Way, Emmons Dr, Farber Rd)
streetWidth.estimate: Two lanes with shoulders; OSM stores centrelines only.

driveAisleWidth.label: Internal drive aisle width
driveAisleWidth.estimate: 24 ft two-way aisle along the OSM service-road centrelines.

stallDepth.label: Parking stall depth
stallDepth.estimate: 18 ft perpendicular stall. Stall strips are placed on both sides of each aisle segment wherever they clear every building, the pool and the deck; the real striping is not published.

stallWidth.label: Parking stall width
stallWidth.estimate: 9 ft; used only to estimate the stall count from strip length.

poolDeck.label: Pool deck width around the pool
poolDeck.estimate: Read by eye from the pool-view photo; not published.

cabana.label: Cabana footprint
cabana.value: 9 x 4.5 m at the north end of the pool deck
cabana.estimate: The pool photo shows an open pergola-style cabana at one end of the pool; size and which end are estimates.

siteOutlineOffset.label: Site outline
siteOutlineOffset.estimate: No parcel geometry was reachable. The site polygon is the convex hull of the mapped buildings, pool and drives, pushed out 8 m; its area is compared with the published 23 acres in the scene summary.

typicalBuilding.label: Typical residential building
typicalBuilding.derivation: One of the five simple-rectangle residential footprints (about 68.3 x 24.4 m), modelled in its own axes.

unitsPerFloor.label: Units per floor (typical building)
unitsPerFloor.estimate: 443 units shared by footprint area: this footprint is 8.9% of the residential footprint area, about 39.5 units over 4 stories, so 10 per floor, 5 on each side of a central corridor (the north five between the stair halls). Unit mix and plans are not published.

corridorWidth.label: Corridor width
corridorWidth.estimate: Double-loaded corridor, typical width; not published.

stairHall.label: Stair halls
stairHall.estimate: Two stair halls, 3.2 m wide, at the ends of the north side, with a switchback flight per storey (Pascal's stair tool sizes the risers). Stair positions and widths are not published.

balcony.label: Balcony size
balcony.value: 3.0 x 1.8 m, one per unit, with a 1.8 m sliding door
balcony.estimate: Read by eye from the photos; every unit gets one to match the published 'patio or balcony' for every home (ground floor: patios).

windows.label: Window rhythm
windows.value: two 0.9 x 1.6 m double-hung windows per unit on the long facade, two more on each south end unit's gable wall, one per stair hall, 0.6 m sill
windows.estimate: Read by eye from the photos; the real elevations are richer (bays, paired windows, dormers).

unitMix.label: Approved unit mix
unitMix.quote: "Most of the apartments will be two-bedroom, making up 290 of the 443 units." ... "There will also be 114 one-bedroom apartments" ... "the remaining 29 apartments will be three-bedroom"

affordableUnits.label: Affordable units (approved)
affordableUnits.quote: "The developers have also promised to designate 89 of these units as affordable housing"

accessoryRoofPitch.label: Garage and maintenance roof pitch
accessoryRoofPitch.estimate: Gable roofs read from the aerial rendering; pitch by eye.

poolDepth.label: Pool depth
poolDepth.estimate: Typical residential pool depth; not published.

doors.label: Door sizes
doors.value: unit entry doors 0.95 m wide; building entries 1.8 x 2.3 m glass at both corridor ends; balcony doors 1.8 x 2.1 m sliding

clubhouseRoof.label: Clubhouse roof
clubhouseRoof.value: hip, same pitch as the apartments
clubhouseRoof.estimate: The clubhouse roof in the aerial rendering is a cluster of hips and gables; one hip over its bounding rectangle stands in for it.

amenities.label: Outdoor amenities
amenities.value: heated swimming pool, pickleball courts, bocce ball courts, barbecues
amenities.quote: "heated swimming pool, pickleball courts, barbecues and bocce ball courts" (ROI-NJ, June 2023); "a heated swimming pool and pickle ball and bocce ball courts" (Real Estate NJ, June 2023)

barkParkAndGarages.label: Bark park and garages
barkParkAndGarages.value: bark park; optional garages and storage units
barkParkAndGarages.quote: "The pet-friendly community also has a bark park and an indoor pet spa"; "residents have optional access to garages and individual storage units"

facadeVocabulary.label: Facade vocabulary
facadeVocabulary.value: lap siding in white, tan, light gray and sage; red-brick ground floor on about half the buildings; white trim bands between floors; paired double-hung windows in bays; sliding doors to stacked projecting balconies with railings on white square columns (patios at grade)
facadeVocabulary.estimate: Read from the public renderings/photos (aerial and entrance renderings, pool view, entrance-sign photo; see Reference images) in an earlier session that could view them; this build environment could not download them. Modelled with Pascal library finishes: siding-lap-white / -greige / -gray / -sage, flooring-weatheredbrick on the ground-floor walls, preset-white crown bands, window frames, columns and balcony edges.

brickBaseShare.label: Buildings with a brick ground floor
brickBaseShare.estimate: Read from the public renderings/photos (aerial and entrance renderings, pool view, entrance-sign photo; see Reference images) in an earlier session that could view them; this build environment could not download them. About half the buildings show a red-brick base; which ones is not known, so every second residential building in OSM order gets one.

roofPitchDetailed.label: Residential roof pitch (detailed scene)
roofPitchDetailed.estimate: Read from the public renderings/photos (aerial and entrance renderings, pool view, entrance-sign photo; see Reference images) in an earlier session that could view them; this build environment could not download them. About 32 degrees, asphalt shingles.

crossGables.label: Cross-gables
crossGables.value: a front-facing gable over two bays near each end of each long facade
crossGables.estimate: Read from the public renderings/photos (aerial and entrance renderings, pool view, entrance-sign photo; see Reference images) in an earlier session that could view them; this build environment could not download them. Modelled as gable roof segments joined to the main hip roof, two per long side (where the facade has 7 or more bays).

dormersPerSide.label: Gable dormers per long roof side
dormersPerSide.estimate: Read from the public renderings/photos (aerial and entrance renderings, pool view, entrance-sign photo; see Reference images) in an earlier session that could view them; this build environment could not download them. The count per roof slope is a reading by eye; modelled as two gable dormers per long side between the cross-gables, each with a two-by-two window.

windowBay.label: Facade bay width
windowBay.estimate: Read from the public renderings/photos (aerial and entrance renderings, pool view, entrance-sign photo; see Reference images) in an earlier session that could view them; this build environment could not download them. About 7.6 m (25 ft) bays. Long facades alternate a balcony bay (sliding door) with a window bay; end walls are all window bays, with the entry door centred on the ground floor.

pairedWindow.label: Paired window
pairedWindow.estimate: A pair of double-hung windows modelled as one fixed window with a two-by-two pane grid (Pascal's double-hung type draws a single pair of sashes); size by eye from the photos. Its head stays at least 0.15 m under the storey's wall top.

windowSill.label: Window sill height
windowSill.estimate: Typical residential sill height; not published.

balconyColumn.label: Balcony column
balconyColumn.estimate: Read from the public renderings/photos (aerial and entrance renderings, pool view, entrance-sign photo; see Reference images) in an earlier session that could view them; this build environment could not download them. White square columns under the stacked balconies, two per stack, rising from the patio to the underside of the top balcony; size by eye.

buildingWalk.label: Walk around each building
buildingWalk.estimate: Concrete walks and patios around each building; width not published.

pickleballCourts.label: Pickleball courts
pickleballCourts.value: 18 x 30 m surround for two courts
pickleballCourts.estimate: Courts are published (see Outdoor amenities); two standard 44 x 20 ft courts on a fenced surround. Number of courts and position are estimates: placed on the nearest open lawn to the clubhouse.

bocceCourts.label: Bocce courts
bocceCourts.estimate: Courts are published (see Outdoor amenities); two lanes of about 24 x 3.7 m with timber borders. Placed on the nearest open lawn to the pool; position estimated.

barkPark.label: Bark park
barkPark.estimate: Published (see Bark park and garages); size and position are estimates (open lawn in the west part of the site), fenced with black picket fencing.

treeSpacing.label: Street tree spacing
treeSpacing.estimate: Shade trees along the internal drives, read loosely from the aerial rendering; species, sizes and exact positions are not published. One Pascal procedural design (tree-design.json) with varied height and spread.

notes: The approved unit mix in Community News (114 + 290 + 29) sums to 433, not 443; the 443 total is repeated by every later source, so the mix is context only and is not used in the model.
Planet Princeton (March 2021) says 433 units; Real Estate NJ, Multi-Housing News and JLL all say 443. 443 is used.
The address appears as 200 Emmons Drive (Multi-Housing News, 2020), 100 Woodmont Circle (Real Estate NJ, 2021) and 100 Woodstone Circle (JLL, 2023); Woodstone was the project's approval-stage name.
Multi-Housing News (2020) said "some units" would have a patio or balcony; the 2021 leasing coverage says all homes do. The later, as-built wording is used.
The task brief named woodmont.com as Woodmont's site; that domain belongs to The Woodmont Company of Fort Worth, Texas. Woodmont Properties (New Jersey) is woodmontproperties.com.
